notes: Profile: federal civil defense agency operating critical national infra systems; classified CUI handled in environments up to SECRET-TS (seeking path for CUI/controlled unclassified information first).

Primary contact: Dir. of Technology (Chris Nguyen) + IT Security (Anika Rao). AE intro 2025-02-14 — strong preference for vendor that can ship fully air-gapped, installable appliance and sign BAA/NDA with SCIF handling clauses.
Key quote from CIO: "We cannot allow classified data to transit public cloud under any circumstances. Need on-prem runtime + HSM key custody and attestable supply chain."

Technical constraints: mandatory one-way diode option for data egress (no outbound), FIPS 140-2 HSMs, STIG/SCAP hardening baseline, DISA-like ATO checklist expected, annual penetration test requirement.

Model policy: prefer vetted open weights or Redwood-verified model variants (ability to pin a specific quantized model). Deterministic sampling for audit trails, ability to disable streaming for classified prompts.

Workload: secure chat for operators (conversational ops), automated incident summarization from ingested logs (embeddings + reranking), and internal runbook search. Expect mix of short chat (low latency) and batch embeddings for nightly analytics.

SLA/throughput ask: 95th-percentile response latency under 500ms for short chat with 60 concurrent sessions; batch embeddings job cap of ~20k docs/night with predictable throughput. Cost sensitivity: moderate — prioritizes reliability and compliance over lowest price.

Security review status: initial security questionnaire returned 2025-02-28 (see drive doc), vendor supply chain questionnaire requested 2025-03-03. CISO wants HSM integration diagram + proof of never-exiting-data flow before POC approval.
POC ask: provide air-gapped installer image, deployment playbook for SCIF racks, sample HSM integration (PKCS#11) instructions, and evaluation license for 30 days with local test dataset.
Internal stakeholders: CIO, CISO, Head of Ops, procurement lead. Procurement expecting SOW + pricing by 2025-05 for FY decision cycle.
Tone: terse, checklist-driven. Multiple security reviewers involved — expect iterative questionnaire rounds.
Risks noted: procurement may gravitate to incumbent internal team if vendor onboarding timeline slips; budget hold until ATO milestone met.
